title: How to Build a 360° Management Panel for Seasonal Operations
summary: See how to build one live, 360-degree dashboard combining every aspect of a seasonal rental operation.
body_markdown:
Building a 360° management panel for seasonal operations means occupancy, revenue, guest satisfaction, maintenance, and approvals all come together into one live dashboard — instead of five separate views a manager has to check individually. In **Jestor** , this works because every one of those data sources shares the same connected relational structure.


A true 360° view of a short-stay operation requires combining data types that traditionally live in separate tools entirely — which is exactly why most operators never actually get one.


## What keeps a real 360° view out of reach


- Occupancy data in one tool, financial data in the ERP, guest communication in WhatsApp
- No single indicator combining data across these different sources
- Manual compilation required just to get a combined snapshot
- A "360 view" that's really a periodically assembled summary, not live


## How a connected 360° panel works


- Occupancy, revenue, guest communication, and maintenance data share the same relational structure
- Composite indicators combine data across more than one connected source
- Conditional formatting highlights what needs attention across the whole operation
- The **AI** app builder can generate the dashboard structure from a plain-text description


## Why Jestor fits this use case


- One platform holds the operational, financial, and communication data feeding the panel
- No manual export-and-merge step between different tools
- Non-technical operators can build or adjust this panel themselves
- Updates are live, since the dashboard reads the same data the operation runs on


Data source Connected into the 360 panel


Occupancy and revenue Booking and financial records


Guest satisfaction SLA and communication data

**Does the panel update live as data changes?** Yes, since it reads the same connected data the operation runs on.
